blind_spots_patched: Original Chapters 1–6 omitted U.S. tariff policy risk and Turkey transshipment/routing friction despite direct and deemed exports surging to 90–92% of H1 FY2027 order inflows (₹1,406 crore), led by U.S. data-centre demand.

Original Chapters 1–6 noted the ₹75 crore promoter preferential allotment (₹600/share) and ₹600 crore QIP (₹775/share) without auditing multi-year promoter stake monetization, the preferential-vs-QIP pricing gap, undisclosed QIP proceeds deployment, or recent institutional exits.

Original Chapters 1–6 noted generic top-ten customer concentration (60–70%) but missed the structural shift toward a dedicated single-OEM fourth plant for Siemens Energy's gas-turbine group on a build-to-print basis.
assumptions_changed: CONFIRMED: FY2027 revenue guidance stood at ₹2,600 crore (from Q1 FY2027, the latest call before the 12 Nov cutoff) while FY2028–FY2030 capacity expansion plans remained unverified.
WEAKENED: Railway traction motor stator/rotor supply was framed as an active growth adjacency alongside industrial motors.
CONFIRMED: Indian subsidiary DF Power Systems carried ₹20.4 crore cumulative investment impairment and unresolved legacy project disputes.
